notes.title: Update: achievements and many improvements
notes.content:
Today, I have uploaded a new update for Luna and the Sea.

This includes:
- Achievements! Currently there are 9 achievements you can collect
- Improvements in a few hints, especially around the much-dreaded weighting puzzle
- Improved settings for audio and language
- New supporter DLC: buy the soundtrack to support the further development of this game
- Bug fixes - thank you all for reporting bugs you have found!


If you haven't done so yet, please leave a positive review. This will help other players get recommendations about this game

notes.title: 1 week of Luna - thank you for 10,000 activations!
notes.content:
We have launched Luna and the Sea 7 days ago and just hit the milestone of 10,000 people having "bought" the free game.

Thanks everyone for playing and submitting feedback!

If you would like to support this game, please:
[list]
[*] [b]Please leave a review[/b] - this will help other players find the game
[*] Recommend this game to your friends
[*] Report any bugs or feedback to hello@voidance.xyz
[*] Considering buying a supporter DLC (there will be more launching in the next days and weeks)
[/list]
